title: Nifty DM
tagline: Communicate and connect through NFT’s. Talk to anyone on the blockchain.
description:
PROBLEM
No easy way to connect with creators and collectors.
Use case:
Creators want to reach out to owners/buyers. For future NFT drops, perks, special access, relationship building, revenue splitting
Collectors want to stay connected to the creators. For future NFT drops, perks, special access, relationship building, revenue splitting

Possible integration to other platforms
Patreon / OnlyFans (Private chat access between creators and fans)
NFT marketplaces
Venture Capital investing

Extensible with 3rd party integrations
Bots
Trackers
Notifications
Gamification
Revenue share
Defi
